result.summary: Implemented State A DELETE fix for ISS-0173/GH-501 (src/oidc/jwks.zig orphan). Deleted src/oidc/jwks.zig (538 lines of Zig 0.16-incompatible orphan code via git rm). Removed re-export line at src/main.zig:78 (pub const oidc_jwks = @import("oidc/jwks.zig")). Added per-test UUID-isolated regression test at tests/unit/iss0173_oidc_jwks_orphan_test.zig with 4 tests: TC-01 asserts re-export line is absent from src/main.zig; TC-02 asserts src/oidc/jwks.zig is absent from filesystem; TC-03 asserts it is not tracked by git; TC-04 asserts the literal "oidc_jwks" identifier is absent from src/main.zig. Wired the new test into build.zig as `zig build test-iss0173-orphan` and added it to test_engine_step and test_step. Pre-flight grep confirmed zero callers of oidc_jwks (only src/main.zig:78 itself). Pre-flight zig build was GREEN. Three-phase deliberate-mutation verification completed: Phase 1 (RED) test failed 4/4 before fix; Phase 2 (GREEN) test passes 4/4 after fix; Phase 3 (mutation) re-added re-export and zig build returned RED with "unable to load jwks.zig: FileNotFound" — reverted. Validations: zig build GREEN; zig build test GREEN (267 test-bearing files, 84 addTest roots, 368 reachable — same count as baseline); tools/lint_sql_param_types.py 0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR; tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration OK; tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/unit my new file has zero issues. Committed as 894ee14e and pushed to origin/feature/WF03-GH501-20260808.

Inherited from CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR: SHOULD-2 from diagnosis. Codebase lacks a linter that detects dead pub const X = @import(...) re-exports in src/main.zig. The MUST-8 finding was discovered only by manual grep; a future ISS-0172-class blind spot in a different subsystem would re-occur. Recommend: file ISS-0174 (separate WF-03 run) to add a tools/lint_dead_reexports.py check. Out of scope for GH-501.
